risks.statement: Criteria marked partial or not-executed are future implementation and verification work, not compliance evidence.
Local benchmark evidence is bounded to the documented evaluation environment and is not production assurance.
Partial criteria remain residual uncertainty and must not be consumed as verified evidence.

requirements.statement: The system calculates coverage using the 30-day valid-consumption window.
requirements.verification: automated domain tests and benchmark evidence
